target.title: fix: keep command cron jobs operator-scoped [AI]
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where agent-runtime cron callers could inspect or manually trigger operator-created command cron jobs when those jobs were routed to the same agent.

## Why This Change Was Made

Gateway cron caller scoping now treats command-payload and on-exit cron jobs as operator-only whenever the request comes from an internal agent-runtime identity. Operator and admin Gateway calls without that identity continue to use the existing cron management paths.

## User Impact

Operators can keep command cron automation configured for an agent without making those command details or manual run controls available through the model-visible cron workflow. Normal agent-authored reminder and agent-turn cron jobs remain visible to the owning agent.

## Evidence

AI-assisted.

- `git diff --check`
- AWS Crabbox `run_6432090bdaf0` on `cbx_4469d6f0abd0`: `corepack pnpm test src/gateway/server-methods/cron.validation.test.ts`
- Result: 2 Gateway Vitest shards passed, 204 assertions passed.
